test_title: PYST 30 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 5 days and 15 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

P = 5 days

Q = 15 days

Work alternately, P starts first

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 5 and 15 = 15

⇒ Total work = 15 units</
